device.category: 12-voice binaural hybrid polyphonic synthesizer (DDS oscillators, analogue filters and VCAs), 49-key keyboard or desktop

architecture.polyphony_mode: 12 voices, or binaural: six stereo 'super voices' with a full voice per ear; voice assign POLY 1, POLY 2, UNISON (adjustable size), SOLO, LEGATO; MPE
architecture.patch_memory_note: 128 patches in banks A1-H2 (8 each); 32 user-loadable alternative DDS 1 waveforms (stored per patch); sequences stored separately; files via USB drive.
architecture.summary: Per voice: DDS 1, a super-wave core of seven free-running oscillators (sine, saw, square, triangle, noise or one of 32 alternative waves; 64'-2') with stereo de-phasing and detune; DDS 2, an algorithmic oscillator (six waves, 32'-2', tune ±10 st) that can sync, crossfade by key, become an LFO, a square sub an octave below DDS 1, or carry the external input; MIX balances the two. Analogue path: voltage-controlled high-pass (off, fixed, tracking) into an SSI 24 dB low-pass with drive, then a VCA. ENV 1 (attack hold, attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release; normal, inverted or looping), ENV 2 (with decay hold), LFO 1 (four waves to 50 Hz or 20 Hz-20 kHz, with L/R phase), LFO 2 (triangle per voice). Chorus I/II and delay with freeze. Matrix with fixed sources and destinations plus direct mappings. Arpeggiator and step sequencer.

modules.name: Keyboard and voice assign
modules.description: 49-key Fatar keyboard (velocity, aftertouch) or MIDI; voice assign, binaural pairing, octave and transpose, portamento (interval-dependent), MPE.

modules.name: Bender and pedal
modules.description: Bender: left/right bends pitch (to an octave) and cutoff; pushing up (pressure pad) triggers LFO 2. Expression pedal (0-5 V TRS) as a matrix source.

modules.name: DDS 1
modules.description: FPGA super-wave core: a centroid and six sister oscillators, free-running; classic waves or one of 32 alternative waves; super mode de-phases the sisters in stereo with detune and SWM.

modules.name: DDS 2
modules.description: Algorithmic FPGA oscillator: sine, saw, square, triangle, noise, pulse; phase reset per note; NORM, X-FADE (key crossfade) or SYNC; LFO range (0.1-100 Hz) with sub or audio-in options.

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: Square one octave below DDS 1, replacing DDS 2's audio (RANGE at LFO, mode at SUB OSC).

modules.name: External audio input
modules.description: Stereo input through the DDS 2 channel (RANGE at LFO, mode at AUDIO IN); gain (SHIFT + MIX); gate detector triggers envelopes and LFO 1 reset.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: MIX balances DDS 1 against DDS 2, the sub or the audio input; in X-FADE it sets the split point (two-octave crossfade).

modules.name: VC high-pass filter
modules.description: Analogue voltage-controlled high-pass (non-resonant): off, fixed (about 500 Hz, adjustable with SHIFT + FREQ since firmware v0.27) or tracking the low-pass cutoff for a pseudo band-pass.

modules.name: VC low-pass filter
modules.description: SSI2144 4-pole 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass, self-oscillating; drive off, 1 (saturation with resonance compensation) or 2 (overdrive); auto-tuned for key tracking.

modules.name: Filter cutoff CV
modules.description: Sum of FREQ and every cutoff modulation; drives the low-pass and, in TRK mode, the high-pass at the same frequency.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Analogue VCA under ENV 2 or one of two fixed envelopes (gate; gate with release); LFO 1 tremolo; velocity dynamics.

modules.name: ENV 1
modules.description: Attack hold (to 10 s), attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release (1 ms-10 s); normal, inverted or loop; key tracking of decay and release.

modules.name: ENV 2
modules.description: Attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release (1 ms-10 s); default VCA envelope.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: One LFO per super voice: triangle, square, random, saw at 0.05-50 Hz, or HF (20 Hz-20 kHz) and HF TRK (key-tracked, a third oscillator); delay, L/R phase, free/once/reset; DDS 1 waveform via SHIFT ('Battwave').

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: Triangle LFO, one per voice (polyphonically modulatable), triggered by bender push, aftertouch or always on; rate and delay.

modules.name: Chorus
modules.description: 24-bit stereo chorus: I (subtle), II (denser, faster), I+II (ensemble).

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: 24-bit stereo delay, 1 ms-1 s (or synced divisions), feedback to infinite repeat, level; freeze via footswitch or CC 69.

modules.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator (up, down, up and down, random; 1-4 octaves; hold) and step sequencer (steps, slide, accent, rest, length); 30-300 BPM, swing, MIDI clock; syncs LFO 1 and delay.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo outputs (L alone sums to mono) and headphones; MASTER VOLUME to +4 dB.

connections.note: Exponential FM of DDS 1 by DDS 2.
With SYNC on, cross mod reverses: DDS 1 frequency-modulates DDS 2 (wavefold/PM-like).
HF LFO 1 summed into the DDS 1 channel.
HF LFO 1 summed into the DDS 2 channel.
External audio in the DDS 2 channel.
Gate detector: input above the threshold (set by input gain) triggers the envelopes; off in POLY 2.
Also resets LFO 1 in RESET mode.
TRK locks the high-pass to the low-pass cutoff for a pseudo band-pass; the HPF is not resonant (owner report).
Voices summed in stereo (binaural pairs to left and right).

mod_matrix.note: MOD ASSIGN: buttons 1-8 are sources, A-H destinations; pick either first, then the other, and set depth with MOD AMOUNT (-100% to +100%, shown on the 16 LEDs). Holding a source and moving a continuous panel control creates a direct parameter mapping (22 destinations; switches excluded). SHIFT + MOD ASSIGN clears all, or all for the selected source or destination (desktop: push MOD AMOUNT). Keyboard sources 7/8 are bender left/right; desktop sources 7/8 are pitch bend wheel and note number.

behaviours.name: Binaural mode
behaviours.rule: Pairs the 12 voices into six stereo super voices, one per ear, so oscillator, LFO 1 phase and other parameters can differ left and right. Forced on by DDS 2 X-FADE and filter key tracking. Non-binaural: 12 voices, LR PHASE becomes pan spread.

behaviours.name: DDS 1 super mode
behaviours.rule: Seven free-running oscillators; super mode (half, with phase reset, or full) de-phases the six sisters in stereo; PW/DETUNE sets the spread and PWM/SWM modulates it.

behaviours.name: DDS 2 modes
behaviours.rule: NORM; X-FADE (DDS 1 to DDS 2 across a two-octave zone around MIX's split point); SYNC (DDS 2 slaved to DDS 1, cross mod reversed). RANGE at LFO removes DDS 2 from audio (0.1-100 Hz LFO, matrix and VCF source) and allows the square sub or the audio input in its channel.

behaviours.name: Filters
behaviours.rule: High-pass (off, fixed around 500 Hz, or tracking for band-pass) into the SSI 24 dB low-pass with drive off/1/2; modulated by ENV 1/2, LFO 1, DDS 2, LFO 2, bender, velocity and key tracking.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: ENV 1: attack hold, attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release (1 ms-10 s); normal, inverted or loop (attack/decay hold/decay repeat from the sustain level). ENV 2: attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release; drives the VCA unless a fixed gate envelope is chosen.

behaviours.name: LFOs
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 (one per super voice): triangle, square, random, saw to 50 Hz, or HF/HF TRK to 20 kHz (sine, or DDS 1's wave via SHIFT); free, once or reset; HF can sum into either DDS channel. LFO 2: triangle per voice, triggered by bender push, aftertouch or always on.

behaviours.name: Effects
behaviours.rule: Chorus (I, II, both) then delay (to 1 s, synced divisions, infinite feedback, freeze by footswitch or CC 69).

behaviours.name: Voice assign
behaviours.rule: POLY 1 (default) lets releases overlap; POLY 2 curtails them; SOLO and LEGATO are monophonic (LEGATO without retrigger); UNISON stacks 3 or 6 binaural voices, or 6 as an octave, octave and fifth, or major chord. Binaural off gives 12 mono voices with PAN spread; true mono: left output, binaural off, PAN 100%.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
behaviours.rule: Arpeggiator: up, down, up and down, random; 1-4 octaves; HOLD latches. Sequencer: 64 steps on four pages of 16; tracks STEP (notes/chords, and bender position), SLIDE (ties; glide with portamento), ACCENT (with DYNAMICS), REST and LENGTH; HOLD transposes from C4; 16 stored sequences. Tempo 30-300 BPM or divisions of external clock; swing 0-4; SYNC locks LFO 1 and delay; EXT CLK sets clock tx/rx, note output and stop handling.

behaviours.name: MPE
behaviours.rule: Per-note channels; limited to six voices (the analogue CV allows six independent sets). Pitch bend via the bender settings, Y axis via CC 74 (cutoff), pressure via aftertouch routings; options for an aftertouch dead zone and reduced Y sensitivity, stored per patch.

behaviours.name: Files
behaviours.rule: Hold PATCH at power-up for the SUPER6 drive (patch_banks a1-h2, waveforms, alt_waveforms, sequences); hold SHIFT for SUPER6-BOOT (firmware, init_patch.s6). Alternative waves: 16-bit signed, 4096-point single cycle, band-limited to 512 Hz content, raw .ws6.

behaviours.name: Patches
behaviours.rule: 128 patches (A1-H2 x 8). Edits flash the patch LED; hold a number 3 s to store; press the same number to compare. MANUAL plays the panel; SHIFT + MANUAL loads INIT (also at power-up). Firmware via the SUPER6-BOOT drive.

source_inconsistencies: The DDS 2 RANGE text says it adjusts 'the coarse frequency of DDS 1'.
The manual says binaural mode 'is always be enabled' with X-FADE (typo); LFO 2 text repeats 'the the'.
Backing up patches refers to folders 'patch_banks_a' and 'patch_banks_b'; the drive structure shows a single 'patch_banks' folder.

The community midi.guide chart differs from the official table: chorus as CC 14/15 (officially CC 93; CC 14 is sequence load), CC 92 as VCF LFO 1 (officially VCA LFO 1), CC 81 'Sync' (officially clock sync), CC 89/90 as sequencer record/length (unassigned).

Early-firmware forum descriptions list matrix destination H as 'LFO 1 phase'; the manual names it LR phase. Desktop sources 7/8 (pitch bend wheel, note number) differ from the keyboard's bender left/right.
The PDF has 140 pages; the manual's own numbering ends at 138.
Some retailer specifications describe the high-pass as fixed-frequency with on/off; firmware v0.27 made it fully voltage-controlled (variable in FIX via SHIFT, tracking in TRK).
Pre-launch specifications listed 64 sequence memories; the manual gives 16.

modelling_gaps.detail: Voice modules are modelled once (per_voice); left/right independence in binaural mode is a behaviour.

The keyboard model is modelled; the desktop replaces the bender with pitch bend/mod wheel, adds LFO 2 MODE (MW, MW+AT, always on), I DDS II/VCF/VCA destination buttons with MOD AMOUNT, direct mod wheel assignment and a TRNSP button.
DDS 2 MODE and its RANGE-at-LFO meaning are modelled as two parameters sharing CC 36.
